architecture:
System: Identity-Hub-125
Primary NIST family: Program Management (PM); evidence focus: PM-5.
Environment: Azure. Network access uses Private Link; public ingress to managed data services is blocked. Transport uses TLS 1.3 and strict mTLS for service-to-service paths. Privileged administrators use hardware-backed MFA. Sensitive data and secrets are encrypted at rest with a customer-managed Key Vault key. Control evidence: an authoritative inventory of organizational systems is maintained and reviewed. No exceptions, overdue findings, plaintext channels, public databases, or privileged-authentication gaps are reported.
